new_gain.name: frequency-weighted hysteretic packet-switch Carleson estimate
new_gain.status: CANDIDATE_FULL / SELF-CHECKED / PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW for the mechanism theorem; parent full endpoint remains PARTIAL / OPEN
new_gain.parameters: Q_j=1_[2^j,2^(j+1))(A), P_j=Q_{j-1}+Q_j+Q_{j+1}, eta=1/4, epsilon=2^-12, center weight w_j=2^-j
new_gain.switch_geometry: If the retained packet falls from mass fraction >=1-epsilon to 1-eta and a replacement packet has mass >=1-epsilon, then |k-j|<=2 and at least eta-epsilon of the state mass lies in at most two new boundary blocks. On R<=||Z||<=2R, one of four candidates h in {j-3,j-2,j+2,j+3} grows from <=aR, a=1/32, to >=bR, b=sqrt((eta-epsilon)/2)=0.3533807149.
new_gain.physical_scaling: The dyadic-block stopped hitting estimate carries the physical base frequency 2^h. Multiplying a switch attempt at center j by w_j=2^-j cancels this factor up to 2^(h-j)<=8. This frequency weight is essential; an unweighted switch count is not claimed.
new_gain.weighted_switch: For p in [5/2,3), delta=(3-p)/2, let M_w be the sum of w_j over exogenous starts of localized annular attempts and N_w the sum of the old-center weights w_j over packet switches. Then E N_w <=0.009662 E M_w +217294 delta^(-(p-1)) R^(-p) E int ||Y||^p. If rho=TR^3/J_3>=e^12 and p=3-6/log rho, E N_w <=0.009662 E M_w +178399 (J_3/R^3)(log rho)^2. For zero input, passive center changes add less than 0.97 percent of the exogenous weighted seed clock.
new_gain.localized_duration: While center j is retained, P_j carries at least 1-eta of the state and has spectral condition ratio <=8. The comparable-band log-drift estimate gives segment duration <=6.696 w_j +557.395 R^-3 times its cubic input budget. Summing and using the weighted switch theorem yields total localized annular duration <=6.955 E M_w +4778729 (J_3/R^3)(log rho)^2 for rho>=e^12.
new_gain.connection: This is the missing within-excursion migration estimate in the correct parabolic clock. Countably many packet switches no longer cause an entropy loss: their passive proliferation contracts in the frequency-weighted clock, and active switches cost exactly the critical log^2 cubic budget. The unresolved quantity is now the exogenous weighted start clock M_w, generated by true restarts, radial overshoots, or intervals where the state ceases to be three-block localized.

residual_obstruction: Bound the exogenous weighted start clock M_w by cubic input plus the existing Bellman/Hellinger defect. In particular, prove a dwell-time/seed-charge estimate when max_j ||P_j Z||^2/||Z||^2 drops below 1-epsilon or when a localized annulus is re-entered after a radial overshoot. The earlier unweighted fresh-entry idea is invalid because the physical stopped block estimate carries the base frequency; the corrected theorem keeps exactly the inverse-frequency weight needed to cancel it.
failed_routes_preserved: Generic simultaneous block square-function gluing loses N^(1/6).
L^2 packet localization alone does not control instantaneous Rayleigh quotients because arbitrarily high-frequency leakage may have tiny L^2 mass.
An unweighted union of dyadic block hitting estimates is invalid: physical scaling contributes a factor 2^h. The corrected inverse-frequency weighted count is the valid statement.
next_attack: Use the semigroup Bellman trace, which itself carries inverse spectral scale, together with the state-defect/Hellinger estimates to control M_w at delocalization and radial restart times. Closing that weighted-start charge would combine directly with the new switch theorem and the predecessor exact countable branch gluing toward L^3 -> Z_{3,2/3}.
